verdict.rationale: Lium is a GPU rental marketplace for NVIDIA GPUs with live prices and availability across all rentable nodes. Its docs explicitly show renting an H100 (`lium up --gpu H100`), and rent-by-spec picks the cheapest node that matches a GPU spec under a price ceiling. That establishes current-generation H100 access and choice by spec, but the pack never names H200, B200 or any cheaper previous-generation model (e.g. A100). missing for 10: evidence of H200/B200 availability, named previous-generation GPU options with lower pricing, independent confirmation of the actual GPU catalog.
